takeaway: The transpyloric plane of Addison lies midway between the jugular notch and the pubic symphysis, at L1. The duodenojejunal junction is found at this level.

question.text: Which of the following structures is found at the transpyloric plane of Addison?

lines.text: The transpyloric plane of Addison sits halfway between the jugular notch and the pubic symphysis.
On the body, it is the glowing ring, level with the body of the first lumbar vertebra.
The pylorus of the stomach opens right here, so the doorman guards this plane.
lines.say: The pylorus of the stomach opens right here, so the doorman guards this plane. (laugh)

lines.text: And the duodenojejunal junction is the train station on the ring. That is our answer.
The hila of both kidneys are marked with stars at the same level.
So is the neck of the pancreas, and the portal vein forms behind it.
Remember the ring: L1, pylorus, duodenojejunal junction, kidney hila and pancreas neck.
